proposed_concept.name: Limiting Factors (Blackman's Law)
proposed_concept.summary: The rate of photosynthesis is controlled by the factor nearest its minimal value (Blackman's Law of Limiting Factors, 1905), including external factors (light, CO2, temperature, water) and internal factors (leaf traits, chlorophyll amount, internal CO2).
proposed_concept.ncert_reference: NCERT Class 11 Biology, Chapter 11 Photosynthesis in Higher Plants, §11.10 Factors Affecting Photosynthesis
proposed_concept.naming_convention: kebab-case code matching seed.py peers (photorespiration, c3-c4-pathway, photophosphorylation)
proposed_concept.why_existing_insufficient: photorespiration concept summary and NCERT §11.9 scope do not cover Blackman/limiting-factor theory in §11.10.
proposed_concept.overlap_check: No overlap with photorespiration (oxygenation pathway), photophosphorylation (light reaction ATP), or c3-c4-pathway (carbon fixation routes).
proposed_concept.fragmentation_risk: LOW — sibling under existing topic; does not invent a new chapter/topic.
proposed_concept.future_applicability: HIGH — reusable for NEET items on Blackman law, light/CO2/temperature curves, chlorophyll as internal limiter, and sub-optimal factor reasoning.
proposed_concept.seed_change_required: Add tuple under factors-affecting-photosynthesis in app/modules/academic/seed.py; Alembic data migration or re-seed for deployed DBs.
